summary: BP p.l.c. furnished a Form 6-K disclosing the sale of 5% of its 15.9% stake in Norwegian producer Aker BP at NOK 311 per share, raising gross proceeds of about NOK 9.83 billion ($1.06 billion); the block trade leaves BP with 68.7 million shares, roughly 10.9%, plus a 90-day lock-up on the retained position with customary exemptions. Barclays served as sole global coordinator and bookrunner, DNB Carnegie as co-bookrunner; no board recommendation applies. Proceeds strengthen the balance sheet, lifting 2026 divestment guidance to about $9 billion. Watch the lock-up expiry, residual overhang and further stake sales.
